王野从山寨出来，找了个深不见底的悬崖把空间里的尸体扔了下去。

想了想已经进山三天了，要往回走了。吴志强可是只给了六天假，虽说王野并不怕他这个便宜师父，可是最起码的尊重还是要有的。

满载而归的王野心情格外的好，他并没有原路返回，这一路上让王野糟蹋的够呛。再走原路应该没有收获了，他就选了一个大致的方向前进。

跟进山一个套路，边走边搜刮，一路走来收获还是很可观的，不论是药材，还是猎物。王野都收了很多，唯一的遗憾就是没有碰到大型猎物。这真是想什么来什么，王野在一处山谷里发现了很多的野猪，真的很多。

这个野猪群足足有二十四头，大大小小的野猪。王野开始观察这里的地形，这是一条不算太宽的山谷。山谷全长也不过800米，但是这里不好的是两头都是大森林，进去了就追不上了。

王野只有一个人，没办法两头堵。就这，也想到了办法，他在山谷的一头用手雷做了八个陷阱，陷阱的上面放满了尖锐的石子，只要野猪从这里跑过，那就是一场天女散花。王野并不指望这些陷阱可以杀伤野猪，只要让他们大部分往回跑就成功了。

布好陷阱，王野悄悄的来到山谷的另一端，在一棵大树上王野开始检查所有的枪械。这次王野手里有三把半自动步枪，一轮可以打出26发子弹。

王野深吸一口气，精神力全开抬枪就开始了速射。一把56半十发子弹7秒钟就射完了，六头大野猪率先倒地。在王野换枪的瞬间，剩下的野猪没有按王野的计划往山谷的另一头逃窜，而是向他冲了过来。

王野这能放过他们，又是八枪倒下4大1小五头野猪。八枪五秒的时间野猪已经距离王野不足百米了。王野迅速换出最后一把大八粒，又是八枪，再次有5头野猪倒地。

剩下的八头三大五小，见势不妙转头就往回跑，王野在树上也没有继续射击。而是给三把枪重新上好子弹，等着爆炸声，不到一分钟，爆炸声就响了。王野端着枪聚精会神的等着野猪的到来。

这次只回来了7头，两大五小。王野微微一笑，猪就是猪。当野猪进入精神力范围，王野立刻开枪，一连十枪，七头野猪全部倒地。

这个收获超出了王野的预料，这得益于野猪的第一波冲击。王野在树上等了十几分钟才下来，一路走向山谷的另一头，边走边把野猪收进空间。在山谷的另一头，地上躺着一头大野猪，这头野猪还没有死透，还在那里扭动。

王野抬枪就结束了它痛苦的等待，用长棍子把最后一头收进空间，又把没有爆炸的陷阱拆掉。迅速的离开了山谷，这里闹了这么大的动静难保不会有人来探查。

王野一路疾驰，一直跑出去大半个小时才慢了下来。这段时间王野都没有去搜集东西，找了一个安全的地方，王野解决了午饭问题。没做停留就继续前进，就在王野以为下午就这样平安度过时，一声熊吼让王野精神立刻紧绷了起来。

顺着吼声王野靠近了过去，直到王野走出去八百多米王野才看见两个年轻人，正在一棵大树上，树下一头巨大的熊瞎子正在对着树上的年轻人愤怒的吼叫。

在不远处三条猎犬已经饮恨西北，看样子这俩年轻人这应该是附近的猎人，按理说王野不会多管闲事儿。农夫与蛇的故事王野还是很清楚的，可是看着那四只肥硕的熊掌王野咽了口口水。

不管了这种美食错过了这个村可就没这个店了，王野慢慢的靠上去，在距离不到一百米的地方，树上的两人发现了王野，王野给他们做了个噤声的手势。

Wang Ye came out of the cottage, found a bottomless cliff and threw the corpse in the space.

After thinking about it, I have been in the mountains for three days and I want to go back.Wu Zhiqiang only gave him six days off. Although Wang Ye was not afraid of his cheap master, he still had to have the most basic respect.

Wang Ye was in a particularly good mood after returning home with a full load. He did not go back the way he came, which was quite a waste for Wang Ye along the way.There should be no gain in taking the original path, so he chose a general direction to move forward.

Follow Shan's routine and search as you go. You will gain a lot along the way, whether it's medicinal materials or prey.Wang Ye collected a lot, and his only regret was that he didn't encounter large prey.This is really what he thought of. Wang Ye found a lot of wild boars in a valley, really a lot of them.

There are a total of twenty-four wild boars in this herd, large and small.Wang Ye began to observe the terrain here. This was a valley that was not too wide.The total length of the valley is only 800 meters, but the bad thing here is that there are large forests on both ends, so you can't catch up once you enter.

Wang Ye was alone and could not block both sides.At this point, he also thought of a way. He made eight traps with grenades at one end of the valley. The traps were filled with sharp stones. As long as the wild boar ran through here, it would be a disaster.Wang Ye did not expect these traps to kill wild boars, as long as most of them ran back, they would be successful.

After setting up the trap, Wang Ye quietly came to the other end of the valley. On a big tree, Wang Ye began to check all the firearms.This time, Wang Ye had three semi-automatic rifles in his hand, which could shoot 26 bullets in one round.

Wang Ye took a deep breath, raised his gun with all his energy and started rapid fire.A handful of 56 and a half ten bullets were fired in 7 seconds, and six large wild boars fell to the ground first.The moment Wang Ye changed his gun, the remaining wild boars did not flee to the other side of the valley according to Wang Ye's plan, but rushed towards him.

Wang Ye was able to let them go, and he killed five wild boars, four large, one small, and four with eight shots.Eight shots and five seconds later, the wild boar was less than a hundred meters away from Wang Ye.Wang Ye quickly replaced the last big eight pills and fired another eight shots. Once again, five wild boars fell to the ground.

The remaining eight, three large and five small, turned around and ran back when they saw the situation was not going well. Wang Ye did not continue shooting from the tree.Instead, he reloaded the three guns and waited for the explosion. In less than a minute, the explosion went off.Wang Ye held his gun and waited attentively for the arrival of the wild boar.

This time only 7 came back, two big and five small.Wang Ye smiled slightly, pigs are pigs.When the wild boar entered the range of his mental power, Wang Ye immediately fired, ten shots in a row, and all seven wild boars fell to the ground.

This harvest exceeded Wang Ye's expectations, thanks to the first wave of wild boars.Wang Ye waited in the tree for more than ten minutes before coming down. He walked all the way to the other end of the valley, collecting the wild boar into the space as he walked.At the other end of the valley, a large wild boar was lying on the ground. The wild boar was not dead yet and was still writhing there.

Wang Ye raised his gun and ended its painful waiting. He used a long stick to put the last end into the space and dismantled the trap that did not explode.He quickly left the valley. With such a big commotion here, there was no guarantee that no one would come to investigate.

Wang Ye galloped all the way and ran for more than half an hour before he slowed down.During this period of time, Wang Ye did not go to collect anything. He found a safe place and Wang Ye solved the lunch problem.He continued moving forward without stopping. Just when Wang Ye thought that the afternoon would pass peacefully, a bear roar made Wang Ye's spirit immediately tense.

Following the roar, Wang Ye approached. It wasn't until Wang Ye walked out more than 800 meters that he saw two young people on a big tree. Under the tree, a huge blind bear was roaring angrily at the young people on the tree.

Not far away, three hounds were already drinking in the northwest. It seemed that these two young men should be hunters nearby. Logically speaking, Wang Ye would not meddle in other people's business.Wang Ye still knew the story of the farmer and the snake very well, but Wang Ye swallowed his saliva when he looked at the four fat bear paws.

Regardless of the fact that if you miss this kind of delicacy, there is no such shop in this village. Wang Ye slowly moved closer. Less than a hundred meters away, the two people on the tree spotted Wang Ye, and Wang Ye made a silent gesture to them.
